entries.title: Your first mate keeps answering long conversations
entries.body: Your first mate now summarizes long conversations automatically at 300,000 tokens, or earlier on smaller models. If a conversation still exceeds the model's limit, it continues in a new conversation with recent context instead of repeatedly failing on hello. Your own Claude settings no longer turn this off inside Infinitary.
entries.noPicture: This changes automatic conversation summarization and recovery, not a distinct screen or control.
